scope: Explicit Royal Asiatic Society working-sketch to British Library Lawrence finished-drawing relations, with paper/support metadata and measurement-type controls.
central_claim: At least four British Library finished Nepal drawings explicitly cite original pencil sketches now in the RAS Hodgson collection. The Lawrence finished corpus is normally on English paper watermarked 1840-42, showing that visual copying frequently transferred information onto a newly allocated support rather than merely elaborating the original sketch sheet.

source_control_rules: Do not compare RAS paper dimensions directly with BL within-frame dimensions.
Collection-level normal English-paper state does not prove each paired BL item's support until physically inspected.
Do not date the Nepalese-paper folder to the 1840s without further evidence.
Do not infer exact copying personnel or branch chronology beyond explicit catalogue links.
Keep paper support, medium, image-field dimensions, mount and container as separate fields.
